ITEM 1 | Roasted potato chunks, irregular cubes/wedges about 2-3 cm, golden-brown to deep brown crisp exterior with some darker charred edges, fluffy pale interior visible on cut faces, glossy oily sheen, piled in a loose cluster on the upper left of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Finely chopped green leafy vegetable, bright to dark green with pale yellow-green stem pieces, fine shredded texture, slightly glossy and moist, mounded on the right side of the plate spanning roughly 10 cm by 12 cm | 110
ITEM 3 | Breaded or crumbed meat piece, golden-brown crust with darker browned patches, flattened fillet-like shape about 10 cm long and 3-4 cm thick, cut edge showing pale interior, sitting partly on the chopped green vegetable | 130
ITEM 4 | Second breaded/coated piece, golden-brown crust, triangular chunk about 7 cm by 5 cm and 3 cm thick, pale cream-colored cut interior visible at one edge, placed next to the other coated piece in the center of the plate | 110
ITEM 5 | Fresh herb sprigs, thin dark green stems and fine feathery leaves, scattered in small amount under and between the coated pieces, slightly moist | 5
